title: Nights into Dreams...
overview:
In search of true courage, NiGHTS - and you yourself - take to the sky!

A new kind of flight action that pursues the joy of flying, set in a world of dreams, delivering exhilarating, dynamic excitement!

Claris and Elliot, two children from the city of Twin Seeds, enter Nightopia, the world where all dreams play out. The evil Wizeman is gathering power to rule it, and the children join forces with NiGHTS, a rebel Nightmaren, to stop him.

Free NiGHTS from the Ideya Palace and soar along looping courses through 3D dreamscapes. Collect blue chips, smash the Ideya Captures to recover the stolen Ideyas, and loop around enemies and items with the paraloop before time runs out. Link rings into chains for big scores, then take on each dream's nightmare boss.

- Eight dreams, four each for Claris and Elliot
- Simple one-button flying with acrobatics on the shoulder buttons
- Sega Multi Controller (analog) support
- Memory backup

真の勇気を求めて、ナイツが、あなた自身が、空を飛ぶ!

空を飛ぶ楽しさを追求した、新感覚フライトアクションが、夢の世界を舞台に、爽快、ダイナミックな感動を演出!
